newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Jan-Aug spending well ahead of revenue.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Jan-Aug spending well ahead of revenue.

text.p: Lebanon posted a budget deficit of 1,990 billion pounds in the first eight months of 1996, finance ministry figures published on Wednesday showed.
Expenditure was 4,159 billion Lebanese pounds and revenue was 2,169 billion by the end of August, reflecting a deficit of revenue against expenditure at 47.8 percent.
The 1996 budget law approved by parliament set a deficit of 38 percent for the year.
The 1995 deficit was 47 percent compared with a target of 44 percent.
More than 29 percent of expenditure for January to August went towards servicing public debt, the figures showed.
Internal public debt rose 24.8 percent to 11,997 billion pounds in August from 9,614 billion in January.
